skills.delivery_notes: Self-origin fire ring emanating from caster. Ring geometry (nova/burst-around-self). Large AoE.
Ranged AoE fire wave traveling forward, dealing damage twice (initial wave + fire trail). Closest to cone/arc delivery — forward-traveling AoE wave. Two-hit delivery noted in fidelity.
Wide-screen fire explosion at target location ('covers a pretty wide area, almost the entire screen'). Large ground-targeted circle. Level-30 gated.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Ranged caster: Ring of Fire to clear surrounding area, Flame Wave forward sweep, Apocalypse for wide-screen coverage. Mana-intensive sustained casting.

resource_economy.regen_shape: Insight mandatory; early Energy investment; High Mana Requirements

economy: Flickering Flame fire res reduction — curse:sap rider

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Three distinct fire-AoE delivery shapes (ring, forward-wave, wide-area) form the skill repertoire. Flame Wave 'deals damage twice' (wave + trail) is a DoT delivery note — not a second ailment. Mana-starved economy confirmed via econ-recrawl flag and dossier ('although a little bit mana intensive'). PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_saturation for sustained multi-source fire AoE coverage.
